description: Returns a compact schema, one line per table: `orders(id integer pk, user_id integer not null fk→users.id, total numeric, …)`. Filter by schema and table name (substring). Use it before writing SQL so column names are right. Read-only.

connection.description: Name or id; optional when there is one

schema.description: Schema (default: the connection's, else public / dbo / main / the database)

table.description: Only tables whose name contains this text

name: db_schema

tables.description: One line per table: name(column type [pk] [not null] [fk→table.column], …); views marked [view]

truncated.description: Present when more tables matched than maxTables

title: Show database schema
